title: Club Invitation Links
subtitle: Self-serve club onboarding via universal shareable links
summary: Club managers were adding members one at a time by hand. I designed a magic-link invitation flow, so onboarding became a single shareable link, with domain whitelisting and expiration controls managers own themselves.

title: MyLoyal Design System
subtitle: One library, thirteen brands
summary: The 50+ component library behind the MyLoyal app, themed across 13+ brands and serving 750k+ users, so features ship to every brand at once instead of brand by brand.

title: MyLoyal Activity Feed
subtitle: Dynamic engagement surface for Nordic loyalty platform
summary: Push notifications die the moment they're swiped away. I'm designing a persistent 13-card activity feed, with carousel mechanics and a state machine, so quests, offers, and notifications have a place users can return to.

title: Push Notification Consolidation
subtitle: Unifying scattered campaigns into a coherent admin system
summary: Admins couldn't tell what state a push was in. I'm redesigning MyLoyal's scattered push entry points into one unified flow, with status visible at every stage from draft through sent.
